name: skinny_gemm_tn_stack
description: Stacked G-way skinny TN GEMM group with uniform member width sharing one activation: C[g,M,N] = A[M,K] @ B[g,N,K]^T for g in 0..G-1 (nn.Linear TN weight layout, bias-free, all members same N). Motivation: LLM decode runs pairs of identical-shape skinny projections on the same input every token — Qwen3.8-27B's SwiGLU gate_proj/up_proj (5120->17408, 64 layers) and attention k_proj/v_proj (5120->1024, 16 layers). At M=1..32 each member is GEMV-like and weight-bandwidth-bound. A fused kernel should issue one launch for the whole group, load A once, and co-schedule both members' tiles so tail waves fill the GPU; it also halves kernel-launch count, which matters because batch-1 decode is partially CPU-launch-bound. The bar to beat is G separate cuBLAS calls (the reference loop).

G.description: Group size (number of stacked members). Model groups are G=2.

M.description: Token/row count. Decode is M=1; MTP/small-batch decode up to 32.

N.description: Per-member output features (uniform across the group).

b.description: Stacked member weights in nn.Linear layout (G, N, K); compute a @ b[g].T per member without materializing transposes.

c.description: Stacked member outputs; c[g] = a @ b[g].T.

reference:
# Source: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/d38164a545b4a4e4e0cf73ce67173f70574890b6/torch/nn/functional.py#L2302-L2305
# Source: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/0dad7b822255a0ae261ec45ae937371e859ffd1a/src/transformers/models/qwen3_5/modeling_qwen3_5.py#L727-L734
# Source: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/0dad7b822255a0ae261ec45ae937371e859ffd1a/src/transformers/models/qwen3_5/modeling_qwen3_5.py#L661-L665
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(a, b):
    return torch.stack([F.linear(a, b[g]) for g in range(b.shape[0])])
